g.text: One Next.js app serves the UI and the API; long work runs as durable Inngest functions that drive E2B sandboxes and AI Gateway models.
project · message · version · sandbox · credits · model · github
GitHub OAuth · DB sessions · DB rate limiter
• tRPC mutations enqueue work with inngest.send("agent/run" | "github/export"); Inngest then calls back into /api/inngest to run each durable step.
• Every server box reads and writes Postgres through Prisma; only the main arrows are drawn.
• export-github pushes with the user's OAuth token on the server; no credential ever enters a sandbox or the model context.
